Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 24
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Diederik van Rooijen was born first. The error occurred in step 24 when the Planner stated, "Therefore, Diederik van Rooijen was born earlier." In reality, Reinhold Schünzel, born on 7 November 1888, was born much earlier than Diederik van Rooijen, who was born on 26 December 1975. The Planner misinterpreted the birth dates, leading to the incorrect conclusion.
